caption: We described a made up SEO agency and its audience, and the AI Sequence Generator wrote a 3 step email sequence with two variants per step. Step 1 shows up as raw HTML with spin options like {Hi|Hello|Hey} around the first name field.

Our plain language search, narrowed to one company size and the Netherlands, gave 532 companies. The list shows company names and domains only, and revenue sits behind a locked View Firmographics button. The account email is hidden.
Email Outreach pricing goes by emails per month: Growth $30, Hypergrowth $79 and Light Speed $299 a month. New customers get 30% off the first month on a monthly plan. The avatar is hidden.
